nodes.description: NAD(P)H hydration yields R- and S-NAD(P)HX. The dehydratase NAXD acts only on the S epimer, so the R epimer has to be converted to S by NAXE before it can be repaired. Loss of NAXE leaves the R form stranded outside the repair cycle.

Oral nicotinic acid or nicotinamide, intended to replenish NAD+ during and between crises. Reported doses span from tens of mg/day to 500 mg/day of nicotinamide in a Beijing series, titrated against flushing and perioral rash. The evidence is case reports and retrospective series without controls. In pooled NAXE and NAXD data, 17 of 21 treated patients survived, against two survivors among untreated patients. One NAXE patient died despite the highest niacin dose reported. Kremer et al. first raised the rationale, and trigger avoidance and fever control are usually given alongside.
